_comment: Single source of truth for the wording of a screening result.
Read by frontend-new/src/lib/clinical-copy.ts (Vite import) AND by
backend/pdf_copy.py (json.load). It exists because the React badges and the
ReportLab PDF generator would otherwise each hold their own copy, and
nothing enforces that they agree -- a patient whose screen says one thing
and whose printed report says another is worse than either alone.
Rewording a message is a one-line edit here and needs no migration, which
is why the database stores `recommendation_code` rather than prose.
SCOPE DISCIPLINE: this system was trained on three classes only -- healthy,
COPD, pneumonia. It has no output for asthma, bronchitis, URTI, heart
failure or anything else. No string here may imply another condition was
considered and ruled out. 'Features consistent with' describes a match to a
trained class; it is not a diagnosis, and the absence of a name is not the

headline.COPD_HIGH: Features consistent with a chronic obstructive pattern
headline.COPD_MODERATE: Findings lean toward a chronic obstructive pattern
headline.PNEUMONIA_HIGH: Features consistent with an acute pattern
headline.PNEUMONIA_MODERATE: Findings lean toward an acute pattern
headline.ATYPICAL_OOD_LOW: Abnormal sounds outside this system's training scope

message.HEALTHY_HIGH: The recordings did not show acoustic features associated with the conditions this system evaluates.
message.HEALTHY_MODERATE: Most recordings did not show features associated with the conditions this system evaluates, but the readings were not fully consistent.
message.HEALTHY_LOW: At least one recording was borderline. This is not a confident finding of normal breathing, and it is not a finding of disease.
message.COPD_HIGH: The recordings showed acoustic features resembling those this system associates with a chronic obstructive pattern.
message.COPD_MODERATE: The recordings leaned toward a chronic obstructive pattern, but not decisively.
message.PNEUMONIA_HIGH: The recordings showed acoustic features resembling those this system associates with an acute pattern.
message.PNEUMONIA_MODERATE: The recordings leaned toward an acute pattern, but not decisively.
message.ATYPICAL_OOD_LOW: Abnormal sounds were detected, but they did not resolve clearly onto either condition this system evaluates.

recommendation.HEALTHY_MODERATE: Correlate with clinical assessment. Repeat the recording if the patient is symptomatic.
recommendation.HEALTHY_LOW: Repeat the recording. Assess clinically if the patient is symptomatic; this result does not exclude a respiratory condition.
recommendation.COPD_HIGH: Correlate with spirometry and clinical history.
recommendation.COPD_MODERATE: Correlate with spirometry and clinical history. Repeat the recording to confirm.
recommendation.PNEUMONIA_HIGH: Prompt clinical review. Correlate with observations, vital signs and imaging.
recommendation.PNEUMONIA_MODERATE: Clinical review advised. Correlate with observations, vital signs and imaging.
recommendation.ATYPICAL_OOD_LOW: Direct auscultation and diagnostic workup are required. This system cannot characterise findings outside the conditions it was trained on.

disclosure._comment: Shown on every result regardless of status.
disclosure.scope: Screening support only. This system evaluates COPD and pneumonia and cannot assess other causes of abnormal breathing sounds. A result is not a diagnosis.
disclosure.override: This result was set by a single recording rather than the average. One recording reached the alert threshold on its own.
disclosure.lowAgreement: The individual recordings disagreed with each other, so confidence was reduced independently of the score.
disclosure.borderlineCount: One or more recordings was borderline and did not clear the disease screen.
